verdict.rationale: WorkOS has a feature to let customers connect their third-party accounts to an application, and WorkOS Vault can encrypt and store tokens. Together these hint at a token-vault building block for delegated third-party access. Nothing shows an agent-facing flow that issues short-lived, user-consented tokens for tool calls. Missing for 10: agent-oriented token retrieval or exchange API, short-lived token issuance and refresh handling, documented consent and scoping flow for third-party providers, list of supported providers, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
